messages:
maya: Hey team, customer ACME reported a 3.2x difference between what our SDK estimator showed locally and the invoice for a single-day job. They used redwood-v1-large with a short system prompt + several function calls. Can we triage?

support-jen: Acknowledged — can you paste the exact request payload + SDK version and any invoice line ids?

maya: SDK: js-client@2.3.1. Invoice line id: inv_8Zx. Payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v1-large",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are an assistant for ACME's billing teams."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Summarize today's transactions and call report_metrics()"}
  ],
  "functions": [ { "name": "report_metrics", "parameters": {} } ],
  "stream": true
}
```

support-jen: Thanks — stream=true + function calls can change token accounting on the server (server-side tool outputs and finalization messages may be added). Can you confirm whether ACME used our sidecar tool plugin that returns long structured output?

maya: They did. Sidecar transformed the function output and added an extra system preamble before returning to the model. Our SDK estimator lines up prompt tokens and completion tokens but seems to stop at the streaming boundary; ACME claims the invoice includes an extra ~1.6k tokens per run.

liam: Jumping in — common root cause: server-side tool output + injected system preambles (we add a short verification prompt when tool results are long) which the SDK's client-side estimator doesn't know about. Also streaming resumptions can cause the SDK to undercount if it only tallies bytes until the first close event.

liam: Quick repro I used locally (curlable):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1-large","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are..."},{"role":"user","content":"call_tool"}],"functions":[{"name":"tool","parameters":{}}],"stream":true}'
```
Check server logs for injected messages: meter.injected_system_preamble=true and tool.output_tokens=N.

metering-service: Confirmed — for the ACME runs we see added events: "_server_tool_preamble" (avg 120 tokens) + "_tool_metadata" (avg 80 tokens) + chunk-resume padding (varies). Combined these account for ~1.6k over many calls. The invoice includes all tokens that traversed the runtime (system/tool/meta + prompt + completion).

support-jen: Action items: 1) Ask customer if they can disable sidecar preamble as a test or run with stream=false to compare counts; 2) Metering to provide a per-run breakdown so we can reconcile inv_8Zx; 3) Devex to add an SDK note about estimator differences for streaming + server-injected tokens.

maya: ACME OK to test with stream=false tomorrow. They also asked whether we can issue a one-time adjustment if the invoice is surprising.

billing-bot: Inv inv_8Zx flagged for manual review. Please attach the metering per-run CSV when ready.

liam: Long-term fix: we'll add telemetry to return an optional header X-Redwood-Estimated-Injected-Tokens in stream responses so SDKs can add that to local estimates. Until then we should update docs and surface this in SDK estimator warnings.

maya: Great — I'll coordinate test and attach results. Thanks all :thumbsup:
